_role: Stage G step 8a: dated, labeled amendments to the dynamic layer's registration (fiscal_dynamic_params.json, which stays byte-identical to its commit 87125a0). Each amendment was made after results had been seen, in answer to the independent red-team of PR #483 (lead session, November 24, 2026); dossiers/foundations/fair-financing/notes/dynamic-preregistration.md, 'Changes after registration', gives each one's reason. fiscal_dynamic.py applies them on top of the registration and reports the registered reading beside the amended one.

amendments.what: N-TOP's low end widened from -0.25 to -0.51 so the range includes the anchor it cites (JCT's 2017 dynamic analysis recovered roughly a quarter of the conventional cost; 25% of about $1.1T of FY2040 top-end and corporate revenue is about 0.51% of GDP). Central and high unchanged; the central's departure from the anchor is unverified against the primary sources (JCX-69-17; CBO's 2025 dynamic estimate read directly).
N-CONTRIB's favorable end raised from -0.04 to -0.075, the floor of the registration's own derivation ($40B in FY2040).

Two legacy dynamic rows the registration left out without saying so, added: DY3 (child tax credit without a work requirement, -$0.07T over FY2030-39 at its mid) and DY5 (the carbon fee net of its dividend, -$0.07T), each at its legacy range's FY2040 level.

N-CTC.label: The child benefit without a work requirement: small labor-supply effect (DY3's basis)

N-CARBON.label: The carbon fee net of its dividend: small output drag (DY5's basis)
